== Summary ==
No one is named in the source.

== Description ==

Twin City Comics before the tournament. At the [[June 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (1 June)]], Twin City Comics, Columbia Heights, Minnesota, 1 June 2003.

== Source and credit ==

Shared by [[Nick Kolnik]] (bluethrawn) on his MNSWCCG website; announced in [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=28220#28220 post 28220] in "2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend" (topic 1291), 1 June 2003. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]. The source does not say who took them.

Published on the MNSWCCG "2003 Minnesota SW:CCG Road to States" page, Event Pictures, 06/01, link "Pre-tournament": [http://states.mnswccg.com/road.html states.mnswccg.com/road.html]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040319014922/http://states.mnswccg.com/road.html Internet Archive]
